exposure: neonates hospitalized in neonatal wards and NICUs
Apgar score in the first and fifth minutes
cohort: Neonates hospitalized in two hospitals in Bojnord in 2011-2012
finding: The most common cause of neonatal admission was icterus, and there was a significant relationship between Apgar score, birth weight, and gestational age and causes of hospitalization.
mod_finding: Infants' gender and maternal mode of delivery had no significant relationship with the cause of hospitalization.
